You've wielded the HEAVY sword in Fourteen Fiends! now take control of it with Pike in HEAVY sword! coming soon to Steam! this game also runs on  the STEAM deck!

Heavy Sword is an action adventure Platformer with some RPG elements. Imagine if you took some of the best parts of Zelda II NES, Super Mario World SNES and fused them into something new! Take Control of Pike in his quest to rid the land of horrendous monsters!

Take Control of Pike in his quest to rid the land of horrendous monsters! 
*Gain power ups to Help you in your quest! 
*unlock Steam Achievements!
*unleash the awesome power of the HEAVY sword!
*tons of platformer side scrolling action the likes of which may never be seen again!!




Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Doug's Deadly Dungeon!
notes.notes:
[h1]Doug's Deadly Dungeon! DX3 mode now added. [/h1]
Earn gold by winning rounds in the main game, use that gold to enter Doug's Dungeon, explore the dungeons, upgrade weapons & armor at Smelt the Blacksmith, defeat the Scorn Souls at the end of each dungeon to earn achievements and loot! 
[b]Thanks for supporting 14F![/b] 
If you have time please feel free to leave a review of the game, it would help me out a lot!

notes.title: Fourteen Fiends is releasing on April 11th!
notes.notes:
Fourteen Fiends Is releasing on April 11th 2023! 
Please wishlist & follow! and be sure to snag a copy and leave a review when it comes out ːsteamhappyː

you can also send feedback/thoughts/questions to my [url=https://twitter.com/MonsterRobotGC]Twitter[/url] account and I'll try to get back to you ASAP 

I also added a new "Photo Finish" feature! 
After you win a round you can take a photo of your remaining heroes (and adjust their poses!) 
the photo will also include the stats from that game:
*how many rounds
*how many heroes left
*Difficulty setting
*Game type

hopefully folks will take photos and post them in the community and compare their results! 
I hope you will all enjoy my first game on Steam 

Thanks so much
Have a awesome day
-Ash 
Monster Robot Studios 
-Games for Humans-
